input.quote: Each party is responsible for the supervision, direction, and control of its respective personnel. IBM reserves the right to determine the assignment of its personnel. IBM may subcontract portions of
input.rationale: § 14.8 Personnel, the likely home for any hiring restriction, addresses only supervision, assignment and subcontracting of each party's personnel and imposes no hiring or solicitation restraint. Document-wide searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ", "induce", "recruit" and "personnel" return no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant anywhere in the agreement. Bluefly is therefore free to hire or approach IBM personnel, which matches the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer); no redline is needed and no fallback narrowing is required.
